Name: Qi's Perfection and Completion Tracker
Author: peterbot0
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Qi's Perfection and Completion Tracker[/b][/size]

[b]Track 100% Perfection, explore Completionist goals, and plan your next step in one native-style menu.[/b][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Qi's Perfection and Completion Tracker brings your official Perfection progress, collection goals and recipe planning into one visual dashboard. Open it with a hotkey or from your inventory, see what remains, and hover for practical help finding or making the items you need.

Switch to [b]Completionist[/b] for Community Center bundles, Museum donations, Polyculture and Monoculture. These extra goals stay separate from the official Perfection score. Optional remote bundle donations let you contribute carried items through the tracker while keeping the game's normal unlocks and donation requirements.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Official Perfection[/b]

[list]
[*]Produce and Forage Shipped[/*]
[*]All four Farm Obelisks and the Golden Clock[/*]
[*]Every Monster Slayer goal[/*]
[*]Required friendships[/*]
[*]Farming, Mining, Foraging, Fishing, and Combat skill levels[/*]
[*]All seven Stardrops[/*]
[*]Cooking and Crafting completion[/*]
[*]Every fish in the collection[/*]
[*]All 130 Golden Walnuts[/*]
[/list]
[b]Completionist view[/b]

Switch between [b]Perfection[/b] and [b]Completionist[/b] on the dashboard. The top-left title follows the view; the official percentage stays at top right. Completionist goals never contribute to that score.

[list]
[*][b]Community Center:[/b] choose from six large labeled room icons, then browse native bundle artwork and colors. Selectors have no hover popups. Bundle details show spaced requirement icons with quantity digits above native donation slots. Undonated requirement items are bright; donated requirements turn gray. Hover an item for acquisition help. Uses the bundles selected for your save; Joja farms show not applicable.[/*]
[*][b]Museum:[/b] track actual donations rather than items merely found or carried. Hover for artifact-spot, geode, artifact-trove, monster-drop and mine-soil sources, with geode and trove pictures when help artwork is enabled.[/*]
[*][b]Polyculture:[/b] track 15 shipments of every eligible crop in an item grid. Corner digits count shipments; gray icons regain color at 15. Hover for growing help.[/*]
[*][b]Monoculture:[/b] track 300 shipments of any one eligible crop with the same item-grid treatment. The header identifies your closest crop.[/*]
[/list]
Golden Walnuts remain under Perfection. Their source list groups the vanilla rewards by island area. Click a source to reveal a clue, click again for the solution, then click again to hide it. Hints reset when you close the tracker. The list includes limited random rewards and Golden Joja Parrot completion.

Community Center, Museum and walnut records are shared by the farm. Shipping achievements use the current farmer's counts. Reopen the tracker to refresh progress made by another player.

[b]Optional remote donations:[/b] enable [b]Allow remote bundle donations[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu to donate carried items or pay for unlocked bundles through the tracker. It is off by default. Stardew handles quantities, quality, partial stacks and completion; bundle prizes remain at the Community Center. With the setting off, the view only displays saved progress. Completed optional bundles may no longer retain which items were chosen, so the tracker labels that limitation.

Your inventory appears below unlocked bundles when donations are enabled. Shift-click a suitable stack, or pick it up and click a donation slot. Scroll over the inventory to reach extra backpack rows; unpurchased slots stay locked. Requirement icons and donated item art use the same size and centered spacing.

The Crafts Room becomes available first after learning to read Junimo text. Complete one bundle to unlock the Pantry and Fish Tank, two for the Boiler Room, three for the Bulletin Board, and four for the Vault. Locked pages show the room's requirement and your current completed count without an inventory grid.

Hover requirement items for practical acquisition help, including fish seasons, times and weather, cooking recipe unlocks, and crop, forage, processing or mining sources. The room's completion reward appears at the bottom on Stardew's native reward scroll. This tracker covers the six main Community Center rooms; the later Missing Bundle is not included.

[b]Built to make progress easy to read[/b]

[list]
[*]The dashboard shows your live official Perfection percentage and each goal's contribution.[/*]
[*]Official collection checklists use color to show progress. Community Center requirements start bright and turn gray once donated, keeping the remaining items easy to spot.[/*]
[*]Detailed hovers use a large title panel above a compact help panel, with shared borders and room for portraits, material icons and useful progress information.[/*]
[*]Hover over produce and forage for seed or sapling sources, seasons, planting locations, Greenhouse and Ginger Island use, harvest timing, and forage locations.[/*]
[*]Exact checklist names distinguish white, brown, large white, and large brown eggs.[/*]
[*]Hover over villagers, monsters, buildings, Stardrops, and fish for useful details.[/*]
[*]Search A-Z collection boards to find work quickly.[/*]
[*]Cycle every section between remembered All, Incomplete, and Complete views.[/*]
[*]Dedicated layouts keep Skills, Stardrops, magic buildings, and Golden Walnuts easy to scan.[/*]
[*]The interface uses Stardew Valley's own visual language, including item sprites, portraits, building art, and inventory-style quantity numbers.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Cooking and Crafting planner[/b]

Cooking and Crafting each include three focused pages:

[list]
[*][b]Checklist:[/b] see every recipe and whether it is learned, ready, prepared, or complete.[/*]
[*][b]Needed:[/b] see the combined ingredients still required for every unfinished recipe.[/*]
[*][b]Vault:[/b] remotely store only ingredients that reduce the remaining Cooking or Crafting requirements.[/*]
[/list]
Vault contents are saved separately with each Stardew Valley save. The default category view shows one 12-slot Vault row above your inventory. [b]Expand Vault[/b], on the same row as search and sort, switches to a Vault-only view with up to five visible 12-slot rows and scrolling; [b]Show Inventory[/b] switches back. The Vault accepts only the useful quantity, preventing accidental over-depositing, and can prepare a complete recipe kit only when every ingredient is available and the entire transfer fits.

Recipe help says [b]Recipe learned[/b] for known recipes and gives locked recipes their friendship, skill, shop, special reward, or dated Queen of Sauce unlock route. Ingredient rows use the actual item sprite or a representative category icon. Optional spoiler mode keeps a locked recipe's outlined silhouette and name while replacing its unlock route and ingredients with question marks.

[b]Vault controls[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Deposit the useful amount:[/b] left-click or Shift-left-click an eligible inventory stack.[/*]
[*][b]Deposit one item:[/b] right-click an eligible inventory stack.[/*]
[*][b]Withdraw a stored stack:[/b] left-click it in the Vault.[/*]
[*][b]Withdraw one item:[/b] right-click it in the Vault.[/*]
[*][b]Change the category Vault layout:[/b] click [b]Expand Vault[/b] or [b]Show Inventory[/b].[/*]
[/list]
The layout toggle applies only to the Cooking and Crafting category Vaults. The dashboard's All-Item Vault keeps its existing full-page layout. Preparing a kit does not cook or craft the recipe for you. Stardew Valley's own records remain the final authority for completion.

[size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Load your save.[/*]
[*]Press [b]P[/b] during normal gameplay or from the Inventory page.[/*]
[*]Alternatively, open [b]Inventory[/b] and click the [b]Qi Gem button[/b] directly beneath Organize.[/*]
[*]Choose [b]Perfection[/b] or [b]Completionist[/b], open a category, and hover its entries for details.[/*]
[/list]
You do not need to unlock Qi's Walnut Room first. The Qi Gem button is enabled by default, but you can hide it and change the hotkey through the optional Generic Mod Config Menu integration or SMAPI's generated config file. You can also toggle help-description artwork and unlearned-recipe spoiler mode. If Convenient Inventory's quick-stack button is visible, the Qi Gem automatically moves below it instead of overlapping it.

To donate remotely, enable [b]Allow remote bundle donations[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu, then open an unlocked Community Center bundle. You can also enable [b]AllowRemoteBundleDonations[/b] in the generated config file while the game is closed. Tracking works without enabling donations.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download Qi's Perfection and Completion Tracker.[/*]
[*]Unzip it into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Updating[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Close Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Back up your existing [b]QiPerfectionCommandCenter[/b] folder, then copy the new download's files into it, replacing matching files and keeping your [b]config.json[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
Do not place the new folder inside the old one. Your Vault data remains available after a normal update.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later; the latest stable version is recommended[/*]
[*]No other mod or content pack is required[/*]
[*]No configuration is required; [b]P[/b] and the Qi Gem button work immediately with their default settings[/*]
[/list]
The mod is currently available in English.

[size=4][b]Compatibility and Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Multiplayer and controller-only navigation are not yet claimed as verified.

[b]Compatible mods[/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and lets you change the hotkey, hide the inventory button, toggle help-description artwork, conceal unlearned recipe details, or enable remote Community Center donations in-game.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url] is supported. When its quick-stack button is visible, the Qi Gem automatically moves below it instead of overlapping it.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] is supported. When the live inventory exposes its fourth row, the category Vault split view displays that row too. Remote bundle donation pages provide scrolling for additional backpack rows.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Uninstallation[/b][/size]

[b]Before removing the mod completely, withdraw any items you want to keep from the Vault.[/b]

After withdrawing those items, remove the [b]QiPerfectionCommandCenter[/b] folder from your Mods directory. Removing the mod does not change Stardew Valley's official Perfection records.

[size=4][b]Support[/b][/size]

For version-specific additions and fixes, see the [b]Changelogs[/b] section. When reporting a problem, describe the page you were viewing, what you clicked, what you expected, and what happened. Please also upload your SMAPI log through [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI's log parser[/url] and include the resulting link.
